[chunk_658153690b7b48c8b3ba page=1 kind=extracted_text]

[chunk_9a36669e8f08c3ae62bf page=1 kind=extracted_text]
BACKGROUND

[chunk_3f85a49cbde78ed4a5db page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Since the founding of Wikipedia in 2001, educators around the world have integrated the free encyclopedia which anyone can edit into their curriculum.

[chunk_d52169f5a16ed5c8868e page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Educators and students share free knowledge by contributing to Wikipedia and its sister projects in an academic setting.

[chunk_a3fc82de65e1f728b09e page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Writing Wikipedia is an opportunity to teach students 21st century skills that most will use in their careers and personal lives such as information literacy, collaborative skill, and critial thinking.

[chunk_337f6317f90d5fce0b24 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
METHODOLOGY

[chunk_1625730ca3ff2366f338 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students were introduced to Wikipedia and its education program in class.

[chunk_df23f1f69b669f7b9908 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Student participation in the program was entirely voluntary.

[chunk_0d911136eedda09386cb page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students completed online training: 1) The cores of Wikipedia 2) Editing

[chunk_900745ae6d80d42386c8 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
3) Advanced editing

[chunk_93d21717ab9263d47d56 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students who did not complete the training were excluded.

[chunk_d6ff619c227120c844de page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students worked on text and illustration of their article to meet course requirements. - Students’ work was subject to peer review and scrutiny by other Wikipedians.

[chunk_b6eedd46adfced985b76 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students’ contributions were graded quantitatively and qualitatively.

[chunk_9a0c0eac4d1c2d888c1b page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Exit survey was administered to determine studens’ perception of the program.

[chunk_340fb893448da9a2a92e page=1 kind=extracted_text]
RESULTS

[chunk_fcd66ce78fd3c0fccbd7 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
Students’ contributions

[chunk_6604b7f1d090f1d9a093 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
CONCLUSIONS

[chunk_af00da2d7635ac9b27e7 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Wikipedia writing assignment has been incorported into undergraduate chemistry classes at Mahidol University International College since September 2014.

[chunk_1f4dcdbedbecb6ce7c20 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- One hundred and three students participated in the program.

[chunk_b71a99a8dd601c1c8a9e page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Fifty six high quality articles were created, and more than 81 articles were improved.

[chunk_b6138ac88061b5dc9704 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students’ contrubutions were equivalent

[chunk_2f8bc58cb0951f162257 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
to 364 written pages.

[chunk_9c6fbdf326720a969ab7 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Wikipedia assignment promotes 21st century skills such as critical thinking, collaboration, and information literacy.

[chunk_69fd2f7b4fbf77bc706f page=1 kind=extracted_text]
